dedupe_keys.name: iot based energy and environmental parameters in a smart building m5 building university of sharjah

description: This dataset holds IoT sensor measurements from the M5 building at the University of Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, combining plug-level electricity use of devices such as coffee machines and microwaves with temperature, humidity and occupancy in an interdisciplinary laboratory, a kitchen and a mailroom. It was published on Zenodo by Adel Oulefki and co-authors, with version 2.0 released on 16 July 2024, to support research on energy efficiency and environmental monitoring in smart buildings. Coverage: selected rooms of one university building; the readme gives the structure and period of the data. Access: small zip and tar.gz archives, openly downloadable. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: a few rooms and appliances only, in one building. Simulation uses are occupancy-driven plug-load and HVAC models for buildings in hot desert climates, and testing smart-building analytics. Related records: the BLOND office electricity dataset and the GECAD smart building datasets.
name: IoT-based energy and environmental parameters in a smart building (M5 building, University of Sharjah)
